Dialogs.Dialog: So sleepy... It's impossible not to get drowsy this time of year.
It's spring... Boy, is it ever spring.
Everything even looks warm this time of year, huh？
Hm？ Did you see anything spring-like around？
Spring flowers... Do you know the names of any？
Spring means cherry blossoms, right？ Even if they don't stay in bloom very long.
Spring makes me think of... what, butterflies, maybe？
Spring obviously means new-crop potato chips! Right？
Spring is for sleeping. And no, I don't say that every season.
It's hot. Don't you know I hate the heat？
Hey, aren't you thirsty？ Because I sure am.
When it's this hot, you can see the air shimmering, huh？
Even the scenery feels hot... You know, just looking at it.
Isn't there anywhere cool around here...？
Summer means evening showers, sprinkling water outside... Anything to cool off a bit.
Since it's summer, watch out for the heat getting to you.
Summer... Summer festivals, huh... I'm not really that into music festivals.
Nice that it's cooled down. Figuring out what to wear is a pain, though.
Going out is way better once it cools down. Going outside in the heat makes no sense.
I wish autumn came right after spring.
People say the sky looks high in autumn... What does that actually mean？
Do you see anything autumn-like around？
With all the reds and yellows, autumn scenery is pretty flashy, huh？
In autumn, you've gotta watch out so you don't slip on fallen leaves.
Autumn, huh... If we're talking autumn, I like chestnuts.
Autumn, huh... Didn't you try catching dragonflies when you were little？
Autumn is for art, which means it's for music, which means it's for rock.
So cold... Since I hate the heat so much, I wish I at least handled the cold better.
Brrr, it's cold... Do something about it.
The air's so dry, the wind almost hurts...
You don't really see a classic winter landscape all that often, huh？
When you look at the scenery this time of year... does it make you feel lonely or what？
I don't mind how crisp the air feels, if only it were warmer...
In the winter, I really can't do without hand warmers.
Winter means skiing, right？ I wish it wasn't such a hassle to go, though.
Winter makes you wanna eat ice cream in a nice, warm room, huh？
In winter, Kitty Rinko curls up under the kotatsu.
So sleepy... I might actually fall asleep.
The early bird catches the worm... Well, let's see what I get out of it.
It still feels kind of dim out...
I almost never go out this early, so everything looks kind of fresh.
Makes sense there aren't many people out and about at this hour.
Why do car engines always echo so loud at dawn？
Getting up is rough, but once I'm actually awake, the morning air feels kind of nice.
I could never do a job where you have to get up early. Like a paper route.
I don't know what it is, but the air doesn't feel stale at all right now.
Since we bothered coming out this early, we'd better have enough fun to make it worth it.
No matter how you look at it, I'm definitely a night person.
The morning scenery feels so full of hope... sort of.
Mm, don't the people up and moving at this hour get sleepy？
Judging by the angle of the sun, right now it's... wait, what time is it？
Hey, do you think the weather's going to change this afternoon？
People say you get more done in the morning, but how？ You're just sleepy.
Something I needed to get done before noon... Was there anything？
Hey, are you hungry？ I'm... getting there, I guess.
Afternoons make you sleepy. That's just an undeniable truth.
I want to take a nap. Bet it'd feel great.
Our shadows are so short. Think you can step on mine？ Try it.
It's starting to get a little lively out.
Afternoons are for naps. What else is there？
Why doesn't this country have siestas...？
What's the ultimate lunch to you？ Don't you have a go-to favorite？
I think I'll hold off on my snack chips... for now.
Let's see... What should I have for dinner？
The day's just getting started... Once night falls, that's my time.
Why does the evening always feel so nostalgic whenever you look at it？
The sunset... No, nothing, I was just watching it.
It's so orange... Amazing how the sky turns such a pretty color, isn't it？
Hehe... Is my face sunset-colored too？
Guess this is what they call the twilight hour. Know how to write the kanji for it？
Did you ever sing that song about going home when the crows caw when you were little？
Hey, do you know what kind of bird that is？ Oh, it flew away...
It's finally night. Time for nocturnal people to get moving, like me.
A nighttime date... Just that alone makes it feel special, doesn't it？
Honest question, why do we have to go home once it's night？ 'Because our parents say so' is a pretty lame reason, right？
Hm, spot something interesting？ I actually have pretty good night vision, you know.
Oh... I thought I saw something glint just now, or maybe I imagined it. Like a cat's eyes.
Hmm... Normally speaking, I guess it's about time to head home.
A boy and a girl looking out at the night view... Well, a little cliche isn't bad once in a while.
I wonder what's for dinner tonight.
Hehe, being able to stay together this late is pretty great, isn't it？
Are you sleepy？ The night's still young! ...Though if you're really tired, don't push yourself, okay？
Hehe, I'm not sleepy at all.
Oh, you can actually see a lot of stars.
Pretty pitch black out now... Makes me feel like we've been left behind.
Hey, if you're scared, you can stick close to me, you know？
Okay, it's definitely getting a little cold...
It's so quiet... Kind of makes me want to yell out loud.
Huh, did something just move？ Come on, I'm not trying to scare you.
Up for some late-night potato chips？
Being together at an hour like this... Never mind.
Still not sleepy, huh... Not bad.
Mm... I might be getting sleepy now.
I guess you can't really see anything at this hour...
Oh, a ghost! ...Well, had to get the classic joke out of the way.
Hmm, I wonder how much longer until it gets light out.
Hey, aren't you cold？ I'm a little chilly.
Being up this late kind of sharpens your senses, doesn't it... Zap! Just kidding.
Nobody else is awake right now except the two of us, huh...
Late-night chips... Actually, maybe I'll pass.
Nice weather we're having. From my 'safe small talk' series.
Yep, yep. Even the sun's giving us its blessing.
It cleared up nicely... What, did you make a weather charm or something？
The sky's so blue. Nothing says youth like this!
Clouded over, huh. Shouldn't get in the way of our date, though.
Honestly, it might actually be nicer when it's this overcast.
Sky's looking pretty gloomy. Well, no point letting it drag our mood down too.
Lots of clouds out. Hope it doesn't turn into rain.
When it's overcast like this, doesn't it get hard to tell what time of day it is？
How do you feel about dates in the rain？ There are still ways to enjoy them, right？
Hmm... Are you a rain magnet？
Floors get so slippery on rainy days... Gotta be careful not to fall.
At this rate... I don't think it's going to let up.
It's really coming down. Wonder if it's gonna rain the whole day.
I didn't think it was going to snow.
If it's just a little snow, we don't really need an umbrella, right？
Come on, try falling in a funny way.
A snowy landscape, huh... Yeah, not bad.
At this rate... I wonder if the snow will still be here tomorrow.
Hey, I'm about to get blown away here...
Come on, don't just stand there spacing out. Be my windbreak.
The wind must be strong up high, too... Look how fast the clouds are moving.
It's so windy. Hey... Nothing's gonna come flying at us, right？
Hey, wait a second, that's thunder.
Thunder. It's not going to strike nearby... is it？
If I go, "Eek, thunder is so scary!" and cling to you, do I get bonus points？
Oh, a flash of lightning! Gives off real "Thunder!" vibes.
I think I actually kinda like the moment lightning strikes. How it lights up like a flash.
This place is actually pretty fun. Better than I expected.
I like this place. A date's gotta be fun, after all.
So, what did we come here for？ Is there something fun to do？
Picking a fun spot is Dating 101, huh？
Hm, what is it？ Did you find something fun？
Hehe, don't worry, I'm having a good time.
Wait, am I the only one having fun here？ Come on, you too.
You don't have to worry about me. Just go ahead and have fun.
Come on, you've gotta enjoy yourself too.
Hmm, if we keep going at this pace, I might wear myself out.
Hey, come on, take a look.
I'm glad we could come here together today, too.
Anywhere is fun when you're with me.
Hehe, is that what you're thinking？
Hehe, well, today's been really fun♪
It's nice and calming here... Let's take it easy.
Nice spot... It really puts me at ease.
It's nice and quiet... Like it's giving off those whatchamacallit waves.
This place is really calming... Ahh.
Being here, I might end up getting way too relaxed.
So sleepy... Oh, no, I'm not bored or anything. It's just so soothing.
So, are you feeling nice and relaxed, Grandpa？
Mmm... Feels like all my stress could just melt away at once.
It's like... the kind of thing that heals the weary modern soul.
Hehe, look at you, completely at ease.
I don't know why, but this is weirdly calming.
What makes it feel so comforting, I wonder？ The atmosphere？
This thing's got some kind of power to it. It really calms me down.
You know, the only place I can relax this much...
...might just be right next to you. Hehe.
A quiet, laid-back date like this is nice every once in a while.
Though if we get too settled down, we might start feeling old.
Feels like the two of us could go anywhere.
'Cause as long as you're there, I feel safe anywhere.
Ahh... This is a really nice place...
What a weird feeling... Just being here makes me feel happy.
Hehe, I'm feeling pretty happy right now.
I can tell how you feel, too. It's coming right through to me.
Ahh, it's strange, I feel so fulfilled right now.
Maybe it's just me... but this puts me in a really good mood.
I just felt like saying it. That's allowed, isn't it？
Mm, I just thought... I'm really happy right now.
It's so peaceful here, I could almost fall asleep.
You can really relax here, huh...
Mmm... We can really take our time here.
It's a really relaxing spot, isn't it？
Mm... Oh, was I making a totally spaced-out face just now？
Are you managing to relax okay？
Let's just forget about all the annoying stuff for now.
You look totally soothed. Were you really that worn out？
I wonder why this feels so calming.
It feels kind of relaxing. ...Wait, what part of it？
Hey, think you can relax here too？
Come on, you try going "Mmm..." too.
Even if something was bothering me, doing this would make me forget all about it.
...Not that anything's bothering me. I'm just saying.
'Cause sometimes I wish I could help you unwind like this, too.
It feels nostalgic... Don't you think？
For some reason, this place makes me feel nostalgic.
It's not just that it feels comforting... What is it, I wonder？
Maybe this is what it means for something to feel familiar.
Doesn't this feel kind of like me？
What is this...？ It doesn't feel like a stranger at all.
Why do you think this place feels so nostalgic？
Does this place feel nostalgic to you, too？
Hehe, I've got a feeling there's something special here!
Hmm, looks like something interesting might happen.
My prediction: something's about to happen!
Honestly, I've been feeling weirdly excited for a while now.
Huh, look at this... Wonder if there's something to it.
I don't really know what, though... I just have a feeling there's something to it.
You really do discover something new on every date, huh.
I wonder what we'll find today...
On a date, what matters most is trying to have fun with everything, right？
Not that I'm forcing myself or anything. It's just a matter of attitude.
Hey, look! Huh... That's pretty cool.
All right... Now things are getting exciting!
Hehe, can you tell just by looking？ I'm actually pretty excited.
Pfft... Hey, look at this, it's amazing!
I just figured I should yell something.
Am I getting a little too carried away？
As long as you're having fun too, I guess it's fine.
Doesn't it feel like there's some interesting story behind this place？
Come on, there's definitely something to this place.
Can you tell how excited I am？
It's nice to goof around like a kid every now and then.
I know you won't laugh at me for it.
If something catches my eye, I want to know all about it.
It's fine, right？ Come on, humor me.
I wonder if there's anything around here.
Is there something you want to do？
Huh, so that's what it's about.
So what is this supposed to be, anyway？
I might look it, but I'm having a good time.
We don't have to force ourselves to talk, right？ Just being together is enough.
Huh？ This place is kind of weird.
Something about it just feels off.
What even is this？ It makes no sense.
Here we are, out on a date like this.
When you think about it, the odds of this happening are pretty crazy.
Doesn't it feel a little weird？
This place... I don't know, it makes me a little restless...
Doesn't being here make you feel kind of antsy？
Whoa, my heart's starting to race...
Is it weird to get nervous at this point？
Or maybe it's good to feel like this every once in a while.
I just can't seem to settle down...
Hehe. This place is pretty interesting.
It's a weird spot... in a good way.
...Hehe. Oh, pretend you didn't hear that.
Hey, this is great. It's hilarious!
Come on, you could at least look like you're having fun too, you know？
I feel like I laugh way too much when I'm with you.
Doesn't being here kind of perk you up？
Mmm... This is a really nice spot.
Being out on a date like this... really does put me in a good mood.
Call it date therapy, or something.
Want me to share some of my energy with you？
Around here... I think we're number one.
This is a nice place... Thanks.
I'm a lucky girl. I appreciate it.
And that's because you... Nah, never mind.
Maybe it's okay if we act like a sappy couple a little bit.
Having fun ourselves matters way more than what people think of us, anyway.
Are we really okay... being somewhere like this？
Yeah... Honestly, I'm a little uneasy.
Hey... Never mind. ...Sorry, it really is bothering me.
Are you sure this is really okay？
You know how people say that line？ Sometimes... I think I kind of get it.
Hey... Can I come over next to you？
Come on, of course I'm surprised.
Phew... That caught me off guard.
It caught me off guard at first, but...
To think we'd end up coming somewhere like this together...
This place is kind of... a little creepy, I guess...
I've got a bad feeling about this...
I might be... a little scared.
Are we gonna be okay here...？
I mean, it feels like something's about to happen.
If I told you I was scared...
Of course you'd protect me, right？
As long as you're here, I'm fine.
Hey, what do you think is up ahead？
Now then, let's see what's up ahead.
I actually can't wait, to tell the truth.
It'd be a waste to just rush from place to place, right？
Well, we don't need to be in a hurry, right？
...Oh, I'm not quiet because I'm bored... Come on, we don't need to force a conversation, right？
Hehe, even this counts as part of our date, you know.
Us together like this... Nobody's gonna mistake us for brother and sister, right？
Yeah, I really am having fun.
Even just walking around together feels nice, doesn't it？
Hehe, want me to give you a bite？
Meals are meant to be enjoyed, after all.
I wonder if eating together will just feel totally normal someday...
Being able to enjoy a meal together is a big part of compatibility, don't you think？
Hmm... Hey, are you buying anything？
How about you？ Find anything good？
Maybe a souvenir since we're here... Hmm, maybe not right now.
Hey, which one's good for me？
You're not buying anything pointless, are you？ Wasting money is a minus in my book.
Hey, look at that. What was that again？
Looks like they've got some unusual stuff.
There's gotta be some local specialty dish here, right？
I wonder if we can get around to everything.
Come on, show off all that research you did.
Being somewhere unfamiliar is pretty exciting, huh.
I wonder what it's like to live here.
Nobody knows us out here, right？ Wanna get a little lovey-dovey？
We can look around a little longer, right？
I wonder if there's anything else around here.
We don't have to leave yet, right？ Let's go find something.
Hey, did you find anything interesting？
The scenery around here is actually pretty interesting.
Shall we take a nice, slow walk together？
I wonder if there's something we can do together.
Hm？ You're not bored, are you？
I really like spending time like this...
It's nice being able to take it easy like this.
Even if we're just walking, it's not boring, right？
We'll probably stumble across something sooner or later.
Let's see... Wanna walk a little more？
Hey, isn't there anything interesting around？
Just spacing out and watching the scenery...
Wanna talk about something？ Anything's fine.
Isn't it a pain matching your pace to mine？
Let's just clear our heads and go for a walk.
I wonder what it is... that makes a walk fun.
Looks pretty fun. Hope it lives up to expectations.
Hope we can get right to it. I hate waiting.
I wonder if this is any good. Have you heard anything about it？
Hmm, I see, I see. So that's what it's like.
I'm glad we could do this together. Doing it alone would be...
I wonder how the two of us look to everyone else.
You really need two people for stuff like this.
I had my fill. We should do this again sometime.
Things feel kind of hectic here.
Don't you think this place could use a bit more nature？ What do you think？
Come on, see if you can find a good shop.
...Hey, look at that. Doesn't that place look nice？
Everyone looks so busy. I'll just stick to my own pace.
Let's see here... Wait, do I look suspicious？
There aren't many people around right now. ...Well, this is fine too.
Surprisingly quiet, huh？ Not many people around.
It feels kind of cramped around here.
Lively is fine and all, but isn't it a little too crowded？
Mm... You can see the horizon.
The breeze feels nice. Well, we are right by the sea.
...Hm？ Yeah, I can definitely smell the salt air.
When you shout out at the ocean... saying "Yoo-hoo" isn't quite right, is it...
Hey, do you see any interesting boats out there？
Feels like... we practically have the place to ourselves？
Maybe this is a hidden gem. It's pretty empty.
Figures there'd be a lot of people near the ocean.
So many people. Everyone really loves the beach, huh...
The air feels really clean... I think. Maybe because we're by the water？
Look, the scenery's reflecting off the water...
Hey, hey, do you see any fish？
Mm... The air feels a bit damp here, doesn't it？
Huh？ Did something just splash in the water？
Hehe, this spot's a real hidden gem.
Huh, there's hardly anyone here... I wonder why.
It's pretty crowded. They say humans have a natural instinct to gather near water.
Sure are a lot of people... Well, I guess it's fine.
Mmm... Feels like we're really soaking in nature.
Okay, deep breath. The air tastes so fresh, doesn't it？
Living surrounded by nature isn't really my style, but it's nice once in a while.
Now if only there weren't any bugs...
There's still this much nature left around here, huh...
Being surrounded by nature like this... makes me feel like I could reach enlightenment or something.
Lots of nature, hardly any people... This is nice.
It's nice and empty. Quiet, and nobody's in our way...
There's a lot of people. Guess everyone's starved for nature.
If only it were a little less crowded...
Guess we can't really see the view like this...
It's kind of dark... Are you okay？
Don't you think they could use a few more lights？
Yeah, it's kind of dark, so I'm a little...
Oh, did they dim the lights？
It's kind of dim in here...
It's dark... Can you even see my face properly？
Let's hold hands. Come on, it's dark.
Are you the type to worry about UV rays and stuff？
The sun's strong... Not that I've ever worried much about my skin.
It has a nice, bright atmosphere.
Hm？ Oh, maybe the lights are just really bright.
Do they really need to make it this bright？
Huh... The lighting's actually pretty nice.
It's smaller than I thought it'd be.
Guess it'll be easy to look around, then.
It's pretty cozy. Not that I mind.
Hmm, how far are we allowed to go in here？
Feels a little cramped, don't you think？
We can probably look around this place pretty quick.
It's a little cramped. Oh well.
It feels a bit closed in... Maybe the ceiling's low？
It feels huge and wide open.
Hey, how far out do you think we can go？
I like wide-open places like this.
You can see all the way around...
Just making one lap around looks like a lot of work.
It feels nice in here. Maybe it's the high ceiling.
It feels so open in here, even though we're indoors.
Shall we look around？ Looks like a lot to cover, though.
I wonder where you're taking me. I can't wait.
So, where are we headed today？
All right, let the date begin!
You're going to show me a good time today too, right？
Where are we going again？ Is it a secret？
To tell the truth, I was actually really looking forward to this.
Hehe. Let me guess, you were so excited you woke up early？
If you just stand there spacing out, I'll leave you behind.
This place gets great reviews... Did you do your research？
Hehe, I've been wanting to come here. You know me well.
Nice, nice. I was just wanting to come here.
They say this place is fun. I've heard good things about it.
I hear this place has been getting good reviews lately.
All right, let's hang out here then.
Here, huh... Well, I hope it's fun.
Huh, so this is what you picked.
I haven't heard much about this place... Wonder how it is.
Here again？ You really like this place, huh.
Hmm, haven't we been here before？
Let's head somewhere else. Where should we go...
All right, let's head to the next spot.
Now then, where are you taking me next？
Hmm, I'll leave this one to you.
Next up... Hey, what are we doing？
So, what should we do now？
Okay, so from here... Which way？
Let's see... Let's go that way.
Maybe I'll pick next. This way's fine, right？
Let's see now... Hmm, that way!
Hm, didn't we go that way earlier？ Whatever, I don't mind.
Sure, sure. ...Wait, same way as before？
Hehe, I guess I had so much fun because my boyfriend tried so hard.
That was fun♪ You're getting my hopes up for next time.
Today was fun too. Maybe I'll give you a little praise.
I had a good time thanks to you, though... Hey, you didn't overdo it, did you？
Hey, do you already have plans for our next date？ Today was so fun, I can't help wondering what's next.
Mmm... haah... Hehe, that was a contented sigh.
Are you tired？ I'm, well... a little bit, I guess.
Yeah, I had fun. Let's do it again sometime.
Today's date was... yeah, pretty good, I'd say.
Over already...？ That went by fast.
Well, it's fine, I guess... It just felt a little bit short, is all.
Oh, we're done？ Okay. I had fun.
Yeah, that felt like just the right length. I'm satisfied.
We did quite a lot. Any longer and I'd start getting tired.
Length-wise, this is just about right for a date, don't you think？
Feels like we really went all out. Aren't you tired？
Look at the time... We really made a day of it.
That was a non-stop date. We really packed a lot in.
Say, maybe we could go somewhere different for our next date.
Wait, didn't we go to the same places last time？ Well, whatever.
It's me. Hey, I found a great date spot... Let's go right now.
Right now？ Well, okay... Give me a bit to get ready.
Hey, listen. I actually found a really fun-looking date plan. Wanna go right now？
Huh... Sure. I'll head right over once I'm ready.
Thanks. See you in a bit.
Hey, I know this is sudden, but wanna go out right now？ I came up with a fun date idea.
Right now, huh... Sure. It better actually be fun, though.
Leave it to me. See you soon.
Actually, I brought a boxed lunch with me.
Pretty impressive that I threw it together on such short notice, don't you think？
You caught me off guard asking me out so suddenly, but... I actually brought lunch.
Ta-da, I brought lunch. I worked really hard on such short notice!
Awesome! That must've been tough, thanks!
